messages:
Priya (AE): Prospect asked for BCP/DR details in SIG: RTO/RPO numbers, backup encryption, restore evidence, on-prem failover steps, and SLA copy. Need short, customer-friendly answers + a tiny on-prem runbook excerpt.

Noah (Security): I'll draft. Call out differences between Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (on-prem). Emphasize backups are encrypted at rest (KMS) and in transit.

Lee (SRE): Facts: control plane metadata replicated cross-AZ; for hosted we maintain geo-redundant WAL shipping to standby region; object store snapshots hourly, full nightly; default retention 30d. For Private/on-prem, backups can be pushed to customer storage or our encrypted transfer service.

Noah (Security): Proposed SIG wording (concise): Hosted: Multi-AZ and cross-region standby with encrypted snapshots. Target RTO (control plane): ~45 minutes; RPO for persisted data: ~10 minutes via WAL + snapshots. Dedicated/Private: RTO/RPO are contract-configurable and can be tightened in SOW. Backups: encrypted at rest with customer or Redwood KMS; in-transit TLS.

Lee (SRE): Failover mechanics (summary): automated health checks and routing shift; for region outage we promote standby and update DNS/certificate routing. On-prem scenarios: out-of-band restore using provided restore tool and customer storage endpoint; manual promotion steps documented in runbook.

Noah (Security): Restore testing: quarterly full restores for hosted; Dedicated customers can opt into monthly drills. We can provide sanitized screenshots and timestamped logs as evidence on request.

Tasha (Legal): SLA wording suggestion: "Hosted: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA; Dedicated: 99.95% (contract). Remedies subject to SLA terms, exclusions (customer configuration, network providers), and force majeure." Avoid absolute guarantees in SIG.

Lee (SRE): On-prem runbook excerpt to attach:

```
On-prem restore excerpt
1) Alert: notify Customer POC + Redwood oncall
2) Acquire: fetch latest encrypted snapshot from archive
3) Decrypt: use agreed KMS key (customer or Redwood) to decrypt snapshot
4) Restore: run `redwood-restore --target <cluster> --snapshot <id>`
5) Promote: update local routing and reconfigure certs
6) Smoke: run health endpoints and sample queries
Evidence: include logs (redwood-restore output), checksum, and timestamped checklist entry
```

DR Bot: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/onprem/restore-2025 (last on-prem drill: 2025-04-02).

Priya (AE): Great. I'll paste these into the SIG spreadsheet, request the scrubbed restore artifacts, and follow up.

Noah (Security): I'll pull the scrubbed logs and upload them (24h).

Tasha (Legal): LGTM. Keep hosted numbers conservative and note contractual variability. :white_check_mark:

Priya (AE): Thanks team — sending to prospect now."
